citations.quote: I live alone; there is no spouse or partner living in the flat.
The reason they give is unpaid rent. I did fall behind: three months, CHF 3930, after my hours were cut in spring.
But I am convinced that the real reason is that I complained in writing in April about the broken lift and the noise from the laundry room, and organised a petition with the other tenants.
I have not yet decided whether to ask for more time before moving out, should the termination stand.
According to our records, rent of CHF 3930 is outstanding for the months of March, April and May 2026.
We hereby give you a period of 30 days from receipt of this letter to pay the outstanding amount.
Should the amount not be paid in full within this period, we will terminate the lease in accordance with Art. 257d of the Swiss Code of Obligations.
